subject: RSW_Starmaw
departures: dark body hide densely spotted with point-like bioluminescent lights arranged in star-field and constellation patterns, not plain grey whale skin or whale-shark spots
an oversized filter-feeding maw that dominates the head, open as a huge gaping intake rather than a whale's narrow baleen mouth line
glowing pattern visible across the broad back and flanks as it breaks the surface, so the creature reads as a patch of night sky rising from the water
colossal ship-hull scale, a vast elongated mass with no recognisable dolphin- or whale-style head and blowhole
